heading: Terms of Service
subHeading: Smart JSA Bridge is a collaborative platform where safety managers worldwide share and develop practical knowledge.

section1.title: 01. Acceptance of Terms
section1.content: By creating a Smart JSA Bridge account, you are deemed to have agreed to these Terms and the Community Guidelines. This service aims to facilitate the sharing of safety knowledge and foster mutual development.

section2.title: 02. Service Description
section2.content: This service provides a Safety Knowledge Repository where industrial safety managers can store, share, modify, and utilize Job Safety Analysis (JSA) templates.

item1.desc: Users are responsible for the security of their account information managed through Supabase.

item2.desc: When sharing a JSA to the Public library, users must remove any identifiable security information, including specific site names, equipment names, and personal names.

section4.title: 04. Content Accuracy Disclaimer
section4.content: All JSA templates registered in the library are information voluntarily contributed by users.

item1.desc: The platform does not guarantee the absolute accuracy or site-suitability of the shared content.

item2.desc: Shared material is a reference, not an approved work permit. A competent person must check site conditions, local rules and controls before work.

item1.desc: Rights to the service's architecture, UI, and logic database are vested in the company.

item2.desc: Community reuse v1: ownership stays with the author. Permission covers copying, adapting and republishing for work, with a link to the source and a note of changes. It does not grant rights to third-party material or certify safety. Removing a public page does not recall copies already obtained. Mandatory legal rights remain unaffected.

section6.title: 06. Prohibited Use
section6.content: Mass crawling of other users' knowledge contributions to build a separate paid service or exploiting them for non-safety purposes is strictly prohibited.

section7.title: 07. Global Compliance
section7.content: As this platform is accessed globally, we align our service principles with internationally recognized standards, specifically the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) guidelines. Users are expected to comply with these globally accepted safety standards, as well as their respective local regulations, when contributing content.

section8.title: 08. Termination of Access
section8.content: In the event of inappropriate data posting or a violation of community rules, the platform reserves the right to delete the relevant content or restrict account access without prior notice.

section9.title: 09. Governing Law
section9.content: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea and comply with international dispute resolution procedures.
